fields.text: Reading guide page 4 of 10: charging a 2 MiB chunk from the PD, the quota margins, RM-session upgrades, and attaching pieces around guards. The claim to weigh: this is Genode quota accounting with fixed margins, never Writ budget accounting and never a resource request to the parent. Claim 2 carries a caveat about detaching never-attached pieces. About 20 minutes.
